newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on high Thai offer price.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on high Thai offer price.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Wednesday, supported by higher Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and news that the Thai cabinet had approved a decision to raise its support price for rubber, traders said.
Prices ranged from 3.9 yen to 5.4 yen per kg higher. Benchmark October was up 3.9 yen at 143.7 yen.

Prices extended early gains as short-covering gathered force. "Sentiment turned moderately bullish on firmer Thai offer prices. We are also watching the possible effect of the change in Thai intervention policy," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
